purpose: Cycle 24 N5: gate a CHOSEN definition of the documented VISIBLE axis `health`, which DR 0048 withheld — including on the question it named: whether a player-facing 'health' that is really grid-stability is honest labelling or a euphemism. Two candidates, four gates, refusal first-class.

grid_stability.label: DR 0048's named candidate: the hidden axis, surfaced
grid_stability.rationale: engine truth, moves under the lifecycle, and one of the four lethal conditions (grid_collapse at <= 0.05)

danger_margin.label: how close am I to trouble, on my worst axis
danger_margin.rationale: the MINIMUM normalised safety margin across the engine's own DANGER_THRESHOLDS. DR 0048 rejected a composite because 'any composite needs weights nobody documented' — a minimum has no weights at all, only the engine's published thresholds
danger_margin.rename_reason: DANGER_THRESHOLDS carries five axes and one of them, `bond`, is NOT a lethal condition — only hunger, energy, stress and grid_stability appear in _life_status. A gate asking whether a label is honest may not ship a definition whose own name overstates what it measures

`danger_margin` reads DANGER_THRESHOLDS, which is a PUBLIC name in a PUBLIC module but is NOT in the package's __all__ — so a definition built on it depends on a surface the package has not promised. Adopting it would mean promoting that constant to the public API, which is a package change with its own spec update and gate

decision.rule: pre-registered (cycle 24 N5), refusal first-class and reachable for every candidate. Both definitions are declared CHOSEN up front (the L4 precedent): validity-research.md names `health` and never defines it. G1 — the definition must DECLARE which documented HIDDEN axes it reads; a definition that will not say what it reads cannot be audited. G2 — the KEEPER must be able to move it, judged against what the PLAYER can do (feed, play) rather than what the companion does to itself, with the bar MEASURED as the smallest response any existing VISIBLE axis shows to those same actions, never a constant. G3 — it must be coupled to survival: deaths and survivors must separate on it. G4 — THE LABEL TEST, the question DR 0048 actually asked: put the creature in distress, have the keeper relieve it, and measure whether the bar rises. A bar that does not move when the keeper relieves the distress is a EUPHEMISM whatever it is called, and earns 'refuse_as_euphemism' — a harsher verdict than the 'withhold' a structural failure earns, because the two are different accusations and must not be conflated. This module builds no UI: it decides whether a definition may carry the name.
decision.pre_run_prediction: Written before the run (DR 0045's precedent, so it can be wrong on the record): `grid_stability` is expected to FAIL G2 and G4 and be refused as a euphemism, because the engine's ACTION_EFFECTS move it by exactly 0.0 under both `feed` and `play` — the only two verbs a keeper has — while it falls 0.055 under `mutate`, an action a player would read as growth rather than harm. `danger_margin` is expected to pass, because hunger and energy are lethal axes that feed and sleep move. If the measurement disagrees, the measurement wins.
